To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the creative process is an important goal of curriculum in technology education; (b) it is not well understood; (c) there is a need for a more robust conceptualization of the creative process; and (d) the framework proposed here provides such a conceptualization.
creativity is a process that involves a set of skills and dispositions, which can be developed and nurtured in the classroom.

the nature of creativity in technology education, and the ways in which we might foster it in our students.
the nature of the design process, and how it can be enhanced through the use of design tools.

the nature of creativity in the context of technology education, the development of a framework that can be used in the discourse about creativity in the context technology education, and the application of this framework in the design / problem solving discourse in technology education.
